about.name: Ashwin Keshwaram
about.content: Senior Software Engineer with 16+ years of experience designing, scaling, and operating enterprise web platforms across fintech and content-driven ecosystems. Proven track record of owning end-to-end technical solutions, driving architectural and performance improvements, and influencing engineering practices across globally distributed teams. Deep expertise in .NET platforms and modern frontend frameworks, with experience designing scalable systems, CI/CD, and observability. Applied cloud-native patterns through serverless architectures and infrastructure as code.

list.company: Fincentric (formerly part of S&P Global; now Communify Fincentric)
highlights: Owned technical design and delivery of a large-scale, multi-region, multi-language Sitecore platform supporting 27 regions, 31 languages, and $2T+ in assets under management for a global investment management client
Acted as primary technical liaison across globally distributed engineering and business teams, translating complex business requirements into architectural decisions and execution plans

Drove platform-wide performance optimizations by redesigning caching strategies, tuning Solr search indexes, optimizing Sitecore renderings, and eliminating redundant SQL calls, resulting in ~30% improvement in response times on high-traffic pages
Designed and implemented custom Sitecore pipelines to support complex business workflows, role-based experiences, and extensibility requirements
Established observability and monitoring practices using Grafana and Kibana to proactively identify performance bottlenecks and production issues
Led development of a public-facing fintech web application using React and Node.js, backed by SQL Server, supporting high-visibility client use cases
Mentored and guided engineers on Sitecore, .NET, and platform best practices, improving delivery consistency and long-term maintainability
Contributed to the design and implementation of headless Sitecore JSS architecture for arrow.com using .NET, Angular, and TypeScript
Built reusable Sitecore components enabling content editors and marketers to rapidly create high-traffic, revenue-critical pages
Improved platform stability and developer velocity through consistent coding standards and collaboration with cross-functional teams
Designed and delivered 100+ reusable Sitecore components across multiple high-profile enterprise client websites
Owned Sitecore Experience Editor optimizations, significantly improving the content authoring workflow for non-technical users
Participated in architectural discussions, peer code reviews, and cloud deployment strategies for Sitecore-based platforms hosted in Azure

list.location: Somerville, MA, USA & Raleigh, NC, USA
highlights: Built and scaled Sitecore applications from scratch using .NET MVC, WebForms, Angular, and Backbone, supporting enterprise content platforms
Led Sitecore version upgrades using migration tools, ensuring minimal downtime and backward compatibility
Designed custom authoring workflows and implemented automated unit testing, reducing production defects and improving release confidence
Contributed to the full software development lifecycle of Data Interaction, a large-scale education analytics platform used at state, district, and school levels
Designed and implemented the Analyze module, enabling complex, customizable reporting over large assessment datasets
Developed backend services and reporting features using C#, .NET Web Forms, .NET MVC, and jQuery
